metadata.title: TIMSS 1999 Database User Guide – Supplement 1: International Version of the TIMSS 1999 Background Questionnaires

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This document is a TIMSS 1999 database user guide supplement that provides the international versions of the background questionnaires and the mapping of questionnaire items to international background variable names and questionnaire locations. It does not analyze student achievement outcomes, does not define an analytic sample, and does not specify any weighting or replicate-weighting procedure for estimation. For secondary analyses using TIMSS 1999 microdata, analysts should apply the complex survey design weights provided in the TIMSS international database (and corresponding replicate weights if available) when producing population-representative estimates. Because this supplement is documentation-only, it does not report which weight variables (e.g., student sampling weights) are used in estimation.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This supplement is not an empirical study predicting or scaling cognitive outcomes; it is documentation of questionnaire items and their international variable mappings for TIMSS 1999. Plausible values (PVs) are generated for cognitive achievement scales in TIMSS, but this document does not construct or analyze any PV-based achievement scores. Missing-data handling is therefore not applicable to the supplement’s purpose, because no analytic dataset or estimation model is reported.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: Used for documentation of the TIMSS 1999 international background questionnaire items; no analytic sample is defined in this supplement.

data.outcome_summary: This supplement provides the international versions of the TIMSS 1999 background questionnaires (student general science, student separate science, mathematics teacher, science teacher, and school questionnaires) and the corresponding international background variable names. It includes conventions for how national research coordinators may adapt items using <NRC NOTE:> and <International Option>, while preserving the intended interpretation. The document also lists the questionnaire item field-location format (e.g., SQ2-***, TQM2A-***, SCQ2-***) and provides index tables mapping each background variable to its questionnaire location and whether it was available in the TIMSS 1995 questionnaires. No achievement outcomes, scaling model, plausible values, or statistical estimation results are presented; it is intended to support secondary analyses by ensuring variable comparability across countries and questionnaire versions.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This record is a technical documentation supplement rather than an empirical research article. As such, it does not report an analytic sample, PV handling, missing-data strategy, weighting variables, or any predictive/causal modeling results. The extraction therefore focuses on the assessment documentation content (questionnaire structure and variable mappings) and leaves empirical ML fields empty by design.
